findings: Accepted v04r2 original81-field fixture remains intact; newer93/99-field policies are separate branches of capability, not a silent replacement.
Population v03/v04 are prepared disabled control/objective variants around phase0; there is no new actor checkpoint in those output families.
Stage1v03 phase0 has lower pooled/worst intervention than later Stage1 endpoint on its matched protocol; population endpoints further regress from the same phase0 parent.
Environmentv05 stable merges improve2/9 to8/9, but all four task intervention rates worsen; near-limit raw-action diagnostics improve. This is a multiobjective tradeoff, not blanket head saturation.

V05 remains grade0; cruise109909,following102623,passing9467,merge28000 decisions include warmup. No I110merge/passing training episode. Cruise regression despite substantial cruise exposure cannot be explained by omission alone.

V05 shared actor starts from a semantic/width migration of phase0, fresh critic and optimizer; cross-task shared-gradient updates can disturb retained behavior. Direct causation or classic catastrophic forgetting is not isolated by existing combined experiments.
All actual PPO steps were globally clipped; component gradients showed weak acceleration imitation relative to PPO. Do not infer blanket critic dominance.

The smooth-reference v4 is not a validated teacher for stronger imitation: four nominal comfort cases fail. V5 adjacent caution harmed progress and was restored to v4. No smooth-policy learning occurred.
recommendations: Preserve three explicit references: accepted81-field v04r2 in its original fixture;93-field phase0 as initialization/retention benchmark;99-field v05 as merge-progress research endpoint, not accepted final.

Before choosing a warm start, compare explicitly migrated phase0 and v05 under the same corrected99-field environment/full24 protocol, plus training-only retention probes; no legacy ABI padding or mixed metrics.

Freeze environment/demand/ABI before the next experiment; separate environment corrections from learning and use a task-stratified decision quota ledger rather than assuming episode quotas equal exposure.

Use short on-policy stages with predeclared cruise/follow/pass/merge retention checks; reject or roll back candidates violating earlier skill gates. Keep latest resumable and best eligible artifacts distinct.

Retain fixed training-only foundations every stage and explicitly reserve I110 merge/dense-following exposure. Mastery remains a reported gate; exposure should not be silently denied forever by grade0.

Do not globally amplify imperfect scripted targets. Use bounded supervision only where training-only teacher/constraint validity is established; preserve rawactor/native interventions and retain unknown cases.

Compare an unchanged-objective control against one scoped change, such as a smaller actor rate or explicit retention regularization, with identical startingactor/critic/RNG/scenario order; do not stack untested teacher, schedule, reward and clipping changes in the same attribution claim.
If retention uses saved anchor observations, keep its distillation/KL loss separate from PPO ratios; collect new PPO data on-policy and never use validation episodes as demonstrations.

Defer sensor/latent intent expansion until a scoped information audit distinguishes unobservable cut-in intent from avoidable controller errors. Mandatory braking still overrides comfort; report failures without changing acceptance gates.
missing_evidence: No accepted93- or99-field broad highway policy; only original81-field v04r2 has held-out acceptance in its limited fixture.
No full corrected-I110-network24-case initial-vs-final comparison after the network repair; single-case and training-only comparisons do not replace it.
No multiple training seeds or independent held-out qualification for current highway candidates.
No measured causal benefit of communication across matched no/local/full/impaired conditions.
No actor-wide activation/head saturation claim can follow from weight norms; synthetic empty-cruise probes are narrow, unvisited-state diagnostics.
No actor input for background lane-change intent before visible occupancy; generic adjacent caution was empirically costly, not evidence that all anticipation is impossible.

Some full checkpoints require trusted-local pickle metadata fallback because safe weights-only load rejects stored NumPy/Python RNG types; actor exports themselves load as frozen TorchScript constants.
